assumptions.summary: Paper 7 is treated as an isolated vertex after an asserted source error.
Erdos coauthoring frequency is treated as researcher Authority.
Citation relations are treated as positive and effective.
Non-flow coauthoring makes path measures dispensable.
Unmeasurable self-contribution is set to S=0.75.
Company value and stock ratio can map to initial contribution and control.

candidate_rule_impacts.action: Keep the summary and body distinction between coauthor, citation, ownership, and application claims explicit.
Bind Erdős count, citation effectiveness, DAG status, company value, and control assumptions to visible computational consequences.
Version source-error treatment, node inclusion, relation direction, citation dates, company records, and external ranking comparators.
Exclude office fields, headers, formulas, table cells, captions, and References from positive prose evidence.
State population, relation direction, weights, time window, missingness, and units before each network computation.
Separate coauthor screening, eigenvector comparison, citation contribution, sensitivity, h5-index, ownership transfer, and application logic.
Keep node identity, edge direction, initial value, self-retention, outdegree, rank, and intervention distinct at handoffs.
Preflight all retained formulas for orientation, normalization, time basis, and domain consistency.
Do not claim DAG efficiency or applicability without verifying the graph property and the concrete update rule.
Separate citation count, publication age, centrality, company value, control, and true influence into distinct evidence classes.
Define network membership, relation semantics, parameter policy, algorithm termination, and comparison rule before interpretation.
Separate author, paper, firm, and proposed-action interfaces rather than reusing a score as causal impact.
Use external biographies and ranked-list overlaps only as bounded comparators with explicit matching and population rules.
Report data snapshots, algorithm settings, stability statistic, uncertainty, baselines, and reproducible matrices.
Use S perturbations only with declared range, sampling, output metric, and decision threshold.
Label every rank by graph, source date, inclusion rule, parameter setting, and interpretation boundary.
Trace dissemination, acquisition, and security actions through authority, feasibility, ethics, risk, monitoring, and an alternative action.
Trace each conclusion back through source data, graph construction, formula, table or figure, comparator, and limit.
Retain six numbered figures, seven tables, nine formula structures, one pseudocode flow, and their figure-to-action handoffs.
Retain the discarded path measure, centrality conflict, provisional S, equal-initialization downgrade, and explicit weakness moves.
Evaluate proposed network interventions for inequity, coercion, legal constraints, and harm before operational use.
Do not treat centrality, citations, company values, overlap, or topology as causal influence without a matched design.
Keep paper-implied task requirements separate from unavailable official task wording and preserve all exclusions.
Map extraction to all 19 pages, eight bounded JPEG proxies, focused formula review, exclusions, and zero original-PNG transport.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: The coauthor graph has 511 vertices and 18,000 edges.
Authority screen Ca>=2 leaves 52 researchers before the Importance rank.
Sixteen supplied papers and an expanded citation set are gathered from cited relations.
S values 0.5, 0.75, 0.9, and a random setting are compared.
A dataset of 8,343 firms and 6,726 relationships is narrowed to about 500 media companies.
An external 2001 top-20 company list is used as a comparator.

dependency_graph.handoff: Coauthor and citation relation distinctions motivate different mechanisms.
The DAG premise allows contribution propagation instead of a centrality-only citation rank.
The contribution rank and S parameter feed the displayed stability discussion.
Citation initial value and self-retention semantics transfer to company value and control.
Company ranks are offered as applications but must retain non-causal decision boundaries.

Test whether path mediation predicts an external influence outcome before discarding it.
Define and validate S using an outcome-linked sensitivity statistic.
Release company factor values, coefficients, ownership directions, and cycle checks.
Use a same-year matched firm comparator and a chance-overlap baseline.
Require an authorized, ethical, outcome-monitored intervention design before application.
Implement the stated time-binned, author-paper, and group-influence extensions.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: The Summary's requirement chain makes three relation types scannable but does not establish why this organization earned Outstanding status.
The explicit decision to give up paths makes a modeling boundary inspectable, even though its empirical validity is absent.
Using incompatible centrality orders to justify a new contribution measure gives the method change a visible trigger.
The displayed S perturbation exposes an unmeasurable parameter rather than silently treating it as known.
The final DAG-only and data-factor limits prevent the conclusion from claiming universal applicability.

language_observations.summary: Human style comes from explicit discarded measures, conflicting results, provisional choices, degraded transfers, and concrete scope limits rather than connective-word density.
summary moves across network types without hiding transfer: Name coauthor ranking, citation-DAG contribution, ownership transfer, and the claimed application.
introduction maps the task to relation-specific mechanisms: State why coauthor, citation, and ownership relations require distinct treatments before promising shared outputs.
a premise identifies the population or quantity it changes: State the premise, its operational reason, and the node, edge, or data restriction it controls.
an apparent input error becomes an isolated vertex: Flag the questionable record, isolate its vertex, and retain the correction boundary.
a non-flow relation triggers a deliberate omission: Contrast clique-like and chained coauthor relations, refuse to treat paths as influence flow, and rank with Authority and Importance.
a threshold defines a qualified set before ordering: Filter by Authority, rank survivors by eigenvector Importance, and preserve the threshold.
a ranked list leads to a limited external biography check: Select ranked cases, gather contribution evidence, and state only a bounded consistency claim.
publication time turns citation direction into an algorithm choice: Use temporal partial order, distinguish citation transitivity, then choose topological propagation.
inconsistent centrality ranks trigger a contribution measure: Display conflicting centralities, name the missing mechanism, then define direct and indirect contribution.
a one-way energy analogy becomes a DAG recurrence: Name progressive transfer, define initial contribution and self-retention, then distribute along outgoing links.
an unmeasurable coefficient is fixed provisionally then perturbed: Admit the measurement gap, set a stated value, vary it, and inspect ranking changes.
direct and indirect contribution explain a ranked result: Read initial score and network position together, then explain inherited contribution in the list.
two one-sided group metrics lead to an explicit substitute: Name raw paper count and citation sum as incomplete, define h5-index, and restrict the group-level inference.
a method transfers after its meanings are remapped: Map company value to initial contribution and stock proportion to control before reusing the DAG procedure.
incomplete company data trigger an explicitly degraded initialization: State the data gap, set equal initial values, and reserve the intended value analysis for a later check.
list overlap becomes a limited external consistency check: Match ranked firms to an external top-20 list, count overlap, and avoid causal validation.
a descriptive result is separated from an intervention recommendation: Name the ranking output, describe the proposed use, and retain feasibility, ethics, and outcome requirements.
conclusion routes limits into concrete next work: Restate the result at its network boundary, then name time-binned citations, author-paper linkage, or group influence.
claimed strengths are followed by a scope limit: State topology use and computational claim, then admit DAG-only scope and missing company factors.
a visual is read into a bounded next action: Name displayed topology, rank, or perturbation, state its role, and name the next check or decision.

source_quality.summary: All 19 pages were read twice and visually reviewed. The source presents a Summary Sheet Abstract, literal Introduction, Conclusion, Further Discussion, and Strengths and Weaknesses; proxy, DAG, parameter, data, and application limits remain explicit warnings.

how S and missing data affect a result
what comparator supports only a limited check
whether an application is authorized, feasible, ethical, and monitored
inputs: coauthor records, citation relationships, citation counts, publication years, company attributes, ownership links, stock values, external rankings, and S settings
outputs: coauthor ranks, citation contribution ranks, stability reading, firm scores, overlap count, and bounded applications

title: The research of influence based on the characteristic of a network
unresolved_questions: Erdos coauthoring count is treated as Authority although it conflates access, role, collaboration frequency, and scholarly influence.
The authors discard path measures because coauthorship is not information flow, but do not demonstrate that mediation is irrelevant to influence.
The Ca>=2 screen has no substantive threshold rationale, sensitivity analysis, or excluded-result study.
The post-ranking biography check is qualitative and selected after the result, with no predeclared comparator or validation rule.
Paper 7 is made isolated from an asserted data error without a retained correction log.
Citation relation is assumed positive and effective; negative, perfunctory, strategic, and field-specific citations are not distinguished.
Citation population inclusion has no reproducible search protocol, cutoff date, or complete retained list.
Initial contribution divides citations by publication age without modeling field growth, citation opportunity, or source-date variation.
Self-contribution S is admitted unmeasurable and fixed at 0.75 without a selection rationale.
Table 5 does not define a rank-stability statistic, random-S sampling process, or decision threshold.
The DAG pseudocode does not fully specify update direction and cannot by itself establish a PageRank or HITS efficiency comparison.
The h5-index recommendation lacks aligned population, time-window, and corpus definitions.
Company-value coefficients, units, sources, normalizations, and values are absent; equal initialization later erases the claimed value distinction.
The stock-value ratio omits ownership percentage, indirect ownership, cross-holdings, debt, voting rights, and corporate cycles.
The ownership graph is treated like a citation DAG without showing acyclicity or missing-relation handling.
Nine of fifteen entries overlapping an unrelated 2001 top-20 list is not calibrated validation because the population, matching rule, time, and chance baseline are unspecified.
SNS, acquisition, and strategic-attack applications extrapolate from descriptive ranks without causal, feasibility, or outcome evidence.
Strategic-attack language carries direct harm implications; downstream use requires authorization, proportionality, legal and ethical constraints, and harm minimization.
The stated weaknesses omit data provenance, code, UCINET and Gephi settings, uncertainty, timestamped rankings, and reproducible source files.

All 19 physical pages were read twice and mapped.

visualization_observations.next_action: Trace the values to source counts, dates, S, and the full graph.

visualization_observations.next_action: Define stability, perturbation sampling, and decision tolerance before calling the rank robust.
